name: tranzl
description: Private, on-device translation, text editing and chat

scripts.install-app: npm run pack && rm -rf /Applications/Tranzl.app && cp -R dist/Tranzl-darwin-arm64/Tranzl.app /Applications/
scripts.test: node --test tests/chat-backend.cjs tests/attachments.cjs tests/chat-compaction.cjs tests/local-proxy.cjs tests/server-runtime.cjs tests/verified-assets.cjs tests/secure-store.cjs tests/profile.cjs tests/resource-policy.cjs tests/runtime-probe.cjs
scripts.test:electron: electron tests/chat-ui.cjs && electron tests/attachments-electron.cjs && node --test tests/app-smoke.cjs

author: Zoltan Fekete
